recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is needed for FHIR-18295 unless the work group later changes the semantics of $data-requirements or OperationDefinition.affectsState.
issue_request: FHIR-18295 was a Published/Persuasive CQI change request, raised against STU3 and applied for R5, asking that the Measure $data-requirements operation be identified as idempotent. The approved resolution was to update the operation definition as suggested.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-18295 was found. The current source/measure/operationdefinition-Measure-data-requirements.xml was introduced during the R5 source rework with affectsState=false already present, and Jira later records Bryn Rhodes' comment that the change had already been applied.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Measure and OperationDefinition as active build resources and maps the old OperationDefinition.idempotent element to OperationDefinition.affectsState. A July 2018 Zulip CQI operations thread includes Eric Haas noting that data-requirements is idempotent too. No Confluence references or conflicting community records were found. FHIR-41351 was encountered as a separate later idempotence issue for $snapshot but was not decided here.
reconciliation: No source edit was made because the active Measure $data-requirements OperationDefinition already has <affectsState value="false"/>, which is the current FHIR representation of an idempotent/non-state-changing operation.
